books.name: Thieves' Cant Primer

books.overview: Vocabulary, grammar, and drill exercises. Study it across several long rests to become fluent in Thieves' Cant.

books.name: Bestiary of the Borderlands
books.description: A field guide to the monsters of the frontier, with margin notes from three different owners.
books.overview: Entries on goblinoids, undead, and the great beasts, including which ones can be reasoned with.

books.name: The Planar Compendium
books.description: A scholar's survey of the planes beyond the material world.
books.overview: Describes the upper and lower planes, the elemental chaos, and the perils of unplanned travel.

books.name: Herbalist's Companion
books.description: A practical manual of useful plants, with pressed samples still tucked between the pages.
books.overview: Identification, harvesting seasons, and the brewing of common healing draughts.

books.name: Annals of the Old Kingdom
books.description: A dry but thorough history of the realm that stood here before the current one.
books.overview: Royal lines, border wars, and the collapse that left the ruins now full of monsters.

books.name: Codex of Wards
books.description: A wizard's treatise on protective magic, warded against casual reading.
books.overview: Theory and diagrams for abjuration, from simple alarms to standing shields.

books.name: The Quiet Blade
books.description: An anonymous handbook on moving unseen and striking once.
books.overview: Lockwork, shadow, poison etiquette, and how to leave a room you were never in.

books.name: Hymns of the Dawnfather
books.description: A well-thumbed book of prayers and morning rites.
books.overview: Liturgy, feast days, and the rites for consecrating ground against the undead.

books.name: Dungeoneer's Survival Notes
books.description: Hard-won advice scrawled by someone who clearly survived to write it down.
books.overview: Mapping underground, rationing torches, spotting trapped doors, and when to simply leave.
